summary: Iteration 74: tested the new app layout (splash, account-type welcome, per-type onboarding) and the app commerce features (market, quote, checkout, admin pricing). Backend: 17 of 17 pytest tests pass. /api/app/pricing returns the default values. /api/app/market works for food and products, with q and category filters, and returns 422 for a bad kind. PUT /api/admin/pricing returns 401 without a token, 403 for a customer and 200 for the admin. Inventory saves size_class and kind (product). /api/app/quote math is correct: pickup has a 5% service fee and no delivery fee. A large item delivered over the default 3 miles gives (3.99 + 1.5 x 3) x 2.5 = 21.23. The driver gets 90% (19.11) and Lumo gets the service fee plus 10% of the delivery fee. Delivery checkout without an address returns 422. Pickup checkout returns a Stripe test URL and creates an order with is_app_order=true and status payment_pending. Frontend at 390x844: the splash shows once per session and then the welcome screen with 4 personas. On /start/seller, all 4 choices and 5 auth buttons are present. Apple shows the coming-soon toast. Phone goes to /signin?method=phone with a phone input. Create goes to /register?role=restaurant or retailer, and Log in goes to /signin. The customer lands on /home with 3 tiles and a search box, and all 5 tabs route correctly. Market kind switch, chips and search work, and store cards open /app/store/:id. Checkout UI pickup shows $48.00 items, $2.40 fee (5%), $3.84 tax and $54.24 total. Delivery adds $8.49 for 3 mi and a small item. Pay stays disabled until there is an address, the + button updates the subtotal, and Pay redirects to checkout.stripe.com. Restaurant and retailer /seller/setup show the full form; only the retailer has item-size, and an xl item saved with kind=product. The worker 4-step wizard works through the done screen and lands on /provider. A new customer registered in the UI lands on /home. The real-estate fee note is correct for every listing type. Desktop at 1440: '/' shows website-landing with both badges, the coming-soon text and the pricing section, and /explore still shows PersonaSplit. Admin payments tab shows admin-pricing-card, and save works. Two real bugs: (1) every seeded store page shows 'No items listed yet', so customers can't add to cart from the store page; (2) the store page's View cart button does not appear for an existing cart on direct load or refresh.

critical.issue: Applies hide_demo, which hides inventory from any owner whose email matches *.test. /api/app/market does NOT apply this filter, so the market lists these stores and items. When a customer opens a store page, though, it is empty ('No items listed yet'), and there is no store-add button. In this environment every store (all 12 storefront users) is a *.test account, so the store page add-to-cart flow is broken end to end for customers. Fix: use the same visibility rule in both places, for example by adding a /api/app/store/{id} endpoint that uses the market's filter, or by applying hide_demo in the market too.

minor.issue: size_multipliers is an unvalidated dict. Missing keys, negative values or strings are accepted. Use a typed model with small, medium, large and xl as floats, each >= 0.
It is stored and editable but no real-estate booking or payment code reads it. The RealEstateList note hardcodes '5%'.

It uses cart_items.price_usd, which is the price at the time the item was added. Later price changes by the seller, and items that have since been deactivated or deleted, are still charged. Re-read the price and status from inventory when quoting.

When the address has no lat/lng (typed but not picked from Places) or the store has no location, it silently uses default_miles=3. Many seed stores have location=null, for example Ramona's Boutique. This can undercharge long-distance deliveries.
The total includes US sales tax at 8% on top of the subtotal, the 5% fee and the delivery fee. The user's formula did not mention tax. Confirm this is intended.

ui_bugs.issue: loadCart runs once in useEffect([id]) and returns early while `user` is still null during auth hydration. As a result, store-view-cart does not show for an existing cart on direct load or refresh, until the user adds another item. Add `user` to the effect dependencies.

The placeholder says 'Search food, products, stores', but /app/search always searches kind=food. Searching 'keyboard', which exists as a product, shows 'Nothing here yet'. Search both kinds, or fall back to products when food has no results.

integration_issues.issue: Seed inventory categories (Mains, Dessert, Bowls, Computers, Home, Bakery...) don't match the FOOD/PRODUCT_CATEGORIES chips. Most chips (for example Burgers) return empty, and only a few such as Pizza match. Store page sections use the free-form categories. Migrate the seed data or map the old categories.

issues: Seed items have no media_url, so grey empty thumbnails show everywhere in search results
The App Store badge uses the lucide 'Apple' fruit icon, not the Apple logo
There is a large blank band above the pricing section, likely an un-triggered whileInView animation or extra padding
The Apple coming-soon toast covers the persona title at the top. Acceptable.
The bottom tab bar shows seller tabs (Dashboard, Products...) to a logged-out user on the sign-in page

action_items: HIGH: make store page inventory visibility match /api/app/market. StorePage calls /api/inventory?owner_id, which hides *.test owners, so every seeded store shows no items and customers can't add to cart.
Fix StorePage loadCart so it re-runs when `user` loads, so the View cart button shows for an existing cart
Make /app/search (home search) cover products as well as food, or add a kind toggle defaulting to both
Align seed item categories with FOOD_CATEGORIES/PRODUCT_CATEGORIES so the category chips return results
Validate size_multipliers in PricingIn. Re-price cart items from inventory in quote. Consider requiring geocoded lat/lng for delivery.
Wire str_commission_pct into the short-stay booking logic, or remove it from the admin card
WorkerSetup and AppCheckout.qty: wrap the updateMe, /credentials and cart PATCH calls in try/catch with toast errors (currently unhandled rejections)
critical_code_review_comments: app_commerce.market filters only is_demo, while /api/inventory uses hide_demo with test-email owners. The two views disagree.
WorkerSetup SkillsStep.save and UploadStep.save have no error handling. A failed API call leaves the user stuck with no message.
AppCheckout.qty has no try/catch. Decrementing to 0 empties the cart, and the page then only shows the 'cart is empty' error with no link back to the store.
The ID step in the worker wizard has no skip, but the step bar lets users jump ahead, so the requirement is only soft.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (store page items and View cart broken for seeded stores; home search is food-only)

Left behind: 2 payment_pending app orders (is_app_order) for customer@lumo.test, 1 identity credential (passport TEST123) for provider@lumo.test, a registered customer test_cust_<ts>@example.com, and provider skills set to 'TEST_forklift, cleaning'. Admin pricing was re-saved with the same default values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Set sessionStorage lumo_splash_seen=1 to skip the splash. The fastest way to log in is a page.evaluate fetch to /api/auth/login, then set localStorage lumo_token. /signin now starts with a method chooser (Google / phone / email). Ramona's Boutique id is 16de04c1-7995-4ccc-8d05-1286f0485c0e (retailer@lumo.test). To test checkout, add to the cart via the API and go directly to /app/checkout/:storeId. Stripe is test mode; don't pay.
rca of the issue: Store page empty: StorePage.jsx calls GET /api/inventory?owner_id=X. server.list_inventory calls hide_demo(db, q, 'owner_id', viewer, owner_id), which adds owner_id $nin test_owner_ids() (emails matching \.test$). All seeded storefront owners are @lumo.test, so the result is []. app_commerce.market builds its own query without hide_demo, so the same items show in the market. Reproduce: GET /api/inventory?owner_id=16de04c1-7995-4ccc-8d05-1286f0485c0e returns [], while /api/app/market?kind=products returns 2 items for that owner. View cart missing: StorePage useEffect deps are [id], and loadCart is skipped while useAuth().user is null on first render.
